title: CHRON canonical event store
description: The clock that matters. Every countdown is COMPUTED from target_date at render time — never stored as '21 days'. Expired events leave the active pool. Reference anchor: /root/AAA/scripts/chron.py
THE LAW: Never hardcode a day count. Store target_date; compute delta = target_date - now.
Every event carries a source. A date without provenance does not ship.
Expired events do not display. Stale countdowns are worse than none.
Rank by urgency x consequence x actionability — NOT by nearest date alone.
audience: 'both' | 'arif' | 'syed'. Never name a private deadline for one man in a card the other reads.

state.description: Set by hand when an outcome is known. Expiry by date is automatic.
